nota: Superlativo ATRIBUÍDO ao CRS ('The Columbia River is the largest hydropower-producing river system in the United States'). A classe inteira (geração por sistema fluvial em todo o país) não foi medida. O órgão que mede, a EIA, dá 'contributed 44% of the total hydroelectric generation in the nation in 2012' e 'a little more than one third of all the hydroelectric capacity' (lido hoje), o que torna o superlativo muito provável, mas a EIA não diz 'largest'. A nascente: USGS 1981, F013.

grafias_do_espelho: LARGEST HYDROPOWER-PRODUCING RIVER SYSTEM IN THE U.S.
texto_aprovado: Put your finger on the map where the Columbia River begins. You may know its American end: this is the largest hydropower-producing river system in the United States. Its beginning is somewhere else. It's a lake in the mountains of British Columbia, called Columbia Lake.
